summary: Keep the consumer knowledge snapshot scoped to the design system and its public component examples.
migration: Install the candidate.7/candidate.4 pair, update the consumer lockfile and restart the project MCP. Use the installed index to discover the current document IDs.
rollback: Reinstall the previously verified paired tarballs and restore the previous consumer lockfile and MCP process. Preserve the original artifacts for each version.
visualAndBehavior: Component JavaScript, styles, fonts and Tokens retain their existing behavior. The consumer guides and MCP use the same versioned knowledge snapshot.
